ei.title: New Beginning Dates and Goal Motivation
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: In one study, when researchers suggested that a date was associated with a new beginning (such as "the first day of spring"), students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit than when researchers presented it as an unremarkable day (such as "the third Thursday in March"). Whether it was starting a new gym habit or spending less time on social media, when the date that researchers suggested was associated with a new beginning, more students wanted to begin changes right then. And more recent research by a different team found that similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars. When calendars depicted the current day (either Monday or Sunday) as the first day of the week, people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals.

solverAnswers.reasoning: 어법 Q1: ④ feel → feeling. report + 동명사(-ing) 구조. feel(원형)은 불가. feeling이 정답.
어법 Q2: ④ depict → depicted. 과거 시제 맥락(found, depicted, reported) 일관성. 정답 ④.
어법 Q3: ② achieving → achieved. benefits는 행위를 받는 대상(수동). were achieved by가 적절.
어법 Q4: ① suggesting → suggested. when절 주어 researchers에 본동사 필요. 현재분사는 동사 역할 불가.
문맥상 부적절 Q5: ④ last → first. 새로운 시작 효과 = first day. last로 바꾸면 의미 정반대.
문맥상 부적절 Q6: ④ discouraged → motivated. 새로운 시작 날짜 = 동기 부여. discouraged는 정반대.
내용이해 T/F Q7: T. 원문 'students viewed it as a more attractive time to kick-start goal pursuit'와 일치.
내용이해 T/F Q8: F. 원문은 last day가 아니라 first day로 표시해야 동기 상승.
내용이해 T/F Q9: T. 원문 'people reported feeling more motivated to make immediate progress'와 일치.
빈칸추론 Q10: ③ unremarkable. 새로운 시작과 대비되는 평범한 날 = unremarkable.
빈칸추론 Q11: ② modified weekly calendars. 원문 일치. 수정된 주간 달력 보여줌 → 유사한 혜택.
내용일치 Q12: ② 날짜가 새로운 시작과 연관될 때 더 많은 학생들이 즉시 변화 원함. 원문 'more students wanted to begin changes right then'.
내용일치 Q13: ③ 목요일을 첫날로 설정 — 오류. 원문은 Monday or Sunday.
오류찾기 Q14: ④ last day of the week → 원문은 first day. ①②③은 원문 내용 일치. ④가 오류.
서술형 Q15: similar benefits. 원문 'similar benefits were achieved by showing goal seekers modified weekly calendars'에서 찾아 쓰기.
서술형 Q16: feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals. 원문 'people reported feeling more motivated...'에서 10단어 발췌.
solverAnswers.solverWa: feeling more motivated to make immediate progress on their goals

solverAnswers.reasoning: 서술형-핵심단어 Q17: a new beginning. 글 전체 핵심 표현. 날짜가 a new beginning과 연관 → 동기 부여.
주제 Q18: ① 새로운 시작과 연관된 날짜가 목표 추구 동기를 높임. 두 연구 모두 이 결론 지지.
주제 Q19: ③ 날짜에 새로운 시작의 의미를 부여하면 목표 추구 동기가 향상된다. 글 전체 요지.
서술형-조건영작 Q20: when a date is associated with a new beginning. 조건 9단어 모두 사용. be associated with 수동태 구문.
solverAnswers.solverWa: when a date is associated with a new beginning
